concept.interaction: Place all eight architecture modules upright using quarter-turns from a setup card. Guide ferry C1 to C5 through both high bridges, no lift, building movement or cell revisit. Low gate stops cabin. Lift buildings to reset.
concept.signature: A complete miniature town whose real open bridges admit a finite ferry while the lower gate rejects its cabin.
concept.summary: Build the town. Let the ferry through. A compact canal-town puzzle with two high bridges, a low cabin stop and freely placed architectural pieces.
concept.title: QUAYSHIFT

design_changes: Independent blind review found a tower-like traveler. Reduced cabin top from26 to20mm and gave the26mm-containing hull a tapered underside, flat stern and recessed foredeck. Plan contact envelope unchanged; low gate must still reject actual cabin. Recheck all physical and source evidence.

The ferry underside initially at45 degrees failed the source overhang gate; bottom radius increased10→11mm under13mm upper hull across3mm rise. Exact final ferry bbox26×24.5×20mm remains inside the original26mm diameter by26mm high conservative sweep.
